evan: Lucy from the audit team requested a compact proof package for the March RBAC change + KMS rotation verification. Need minimal artifacts and a 2-line narrative. Who can assemble?

zoe: I can do RBAC diffs and a redacted k8s audit slice. Scope: prod only.

pavel: I'll export CloudKMS events and confirm no key material exports. Use filter window 2026-03-08T22:00Z..2026-03-09T02:00Z.

sec-bot: checklist: include PR metadata (approver), rbacs pre/post, k8s audit slice, kms-events.log, verification statement, README with sha256 sums, redact customer ids, retention note 7y.

zoe: created rbacs_pre.yaml and rbacs_post.yaml, and a small diff patch. Replaced svc emails with <REDACTED-SVC>.

pavel: exported kms-events.log and grep-verified no calls to import/export APIs. Added a one-line verification: "No CryptoKey export/import activity detected in filtered time window."

ev an: can we show CI run id and PR link for traceability?

zoe: PR permalink included: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/5931 (approver: zoe). CI id: ci-20260308-9901. Added both to README.

sec-bot: ensure artifacts hashed.

pavel: computed sha256s and added to README. Uploaded internal raw bundle to s3://redwood-internal-audit/compact/1772003333/raw/ and auditor bundle (hashed) to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/compact/1772003333/auditor.zip

auditor-lucy: link received, thanks. Quick Q: can you include the command you used to verify no export calls?

pavel: included sanitized command: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.ImportCryptoKeyVersion\" OR protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.CreateCryptoKeyVersion\"" --start-time=2026-03-08T22:00:00Z --end-time=2026-03-09T02:00:00Z` and note that only CreateCryptoKeyVersion events for rotation were present.

auditor-lucy: that's sufficient for now. may request a deeper SIEM slice later but this is good.

zoe: closing loop. added control mapping reference in Confluence under CC3/CC7.

sec-bot: ticket SEC-4501 state -> evidence-provided

ev an: thanks team :thumbsup:
